title: Endomorphisms of regular rooted trees induced by the action of polynomials on the ring Z_d of d-adic integers
notes: Shows that an integer polynomial acting on Z_d induces an endomorphism of the rooted d-ary tree and that its sections are again induced by integer polynomials of the same degree. For d=3 this gives established tree-theoretic machinery for finite residue levels; it does not imply that the set of sections or lifting states is finite.
